```abap
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*   INCLUDE LSIFPF10                                                   *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*   Forms für die Dynproschnittelle: allg. Forms
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*

*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       FORM FLAG_SET                                                 *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
* In FLAGBYTE das Bit SINGLEBIT setzen.                               *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  --> FS_FLAGBYTE, FS_SINGLEBIT                                      *
*  <-- FS_FLAGBYTE                                                    *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM FLAG_SET USING FS_FLAGBYTE FS_SINGLEBIT.
field-symbols: <x1> type x.
  assign fs_flagbyte to <x1> casting.
  if <x1> z fs_singlebit.
    <x1> = <x1> + fs_singlebit.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.

*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       FORM FLAG_RESET                                               *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
* In FLAGBYTE das Bit SINGLEBIT zuruecksetzen                         *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  --> FR_FLAGBYTE, FR_SINGLEBIT                                      *
*  <-- FR_FLAGBYTE                                                    *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM FLAG_RESET USING FR_FLAGBYTE FR_SINGLEBIT.
field-symbols: <x1> type x.
  assign fr_flagbyte to <x1> casting.
  if <x1> o fr_singlebit.
    <x1> = <x1> - fr_singlebit.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  OK_FIELD
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Ein Standard-OK-Code-Feld wird an die Feldliste angefügt,      *
*       falls die externe Feldliste kein OK-Code-Feld enthält.         *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
form ok_field tables f type dynpro_field_list.

  loop at f where ltyp = 'O'.          "OK-Code suchen
  endloop.
  if sy-subrc ne 0.                    "OK-Code initialisieren
    clear   f.
```
